profile.summary: bacformer-for-essential-genes-prediction is a Bacformer checkpoint listed in the Bacformer repository README. Bacformer models a whole bacterial genome as a sequence of proteins ordered by their genomic coordinates and computes an embedding for each protein that depends on the other proteins in the genome. The README describes it as a bacformer-masked-complete-genomes finetuned on the essential-genes prediction task. The Hugging Face model API answered the request for this repository with the error "Invalid username or password", so nothing could be read from its model card or weights and this page describes only what the README and the preprint state.

sections.title: How it works
sections.body: Bacformer embeds each protein of a genome with a base protein language model, averages the amino acid token embeddings into one vector per protein, and runs a transformer over those vectors in genomic order, so each protein representation is conditioned on the other proteins of the same genome. The README gives the base protein language models for the two sizes: ESM-2 t12 35M for Bacformer and ESM-C for Bacformer Large.

quotes.text: Bacformer is a prokaryotic foundational model which models whole-bacterial genomes as a sequence of proteins ordered by their genomic coordinates on the chromosome and plasmid(s).

It takes as input average protein embeddings from protein language models and computes contextualised protein embeddings conditional on other proteins present in the genome. Bacformer is trained on a diverse dataset of ~1.3M bacterial genomes and ~3B proteins.
Bacformer (26M parameters) uses [ESM-2](https://huggingface.co/facebook/esm2_t12_35M_UR50D) (`esm2_t12_35M_UR50D`)
